q = Chem.MolFromMolFile('mol2d.mol', sanitize=True)
q = Chem.RemoveHs(q)  # query: atoms 1..32 in my numbering
match = mol.GetSubstructMatch(q)  # tuple: mol idx for each query idx (query idx = numbering-1)
print("match:", match)
mapping = {}  # drawing number -> mol heavy idx

    mapping[qidx+1] = midx

for dn,(x,y) in draw.items():
    midx = mapping[dn]
    P.append(heavy[midx])
    Q.append([x, -y, 0.0])

# scale drawing to angstrom: mean bond length of drawing ~ set scale
# Kabsch: align P onto Q_scaled. First scale Q so its pairwise distances match P roughly
